cards.example_en: The waiter brought our soup and two warm rolls.
cards.example_zh: 服务员端来了我们的汤和两个热乎乎的小面包。
cards.explain_zh: waiter传统上指男服务员；server更不强调性别。

cards.example_en: We travelled around Italy by train last summer.
cards.example_zh: 去年夏天我们乘火车游览了意大利。
cards.explain_zh: 国家名首字母大写，通常不加the；Italian指意大利语等。

cards.example_en: I picked a ripe strawberry and put it in my basket.
cards.example_zh: 我摘了一颗熟透的草莓，放进篮子里。
cards.explain_zh: 可数名词，复数为strawberries。

cards.example_en: My alarm rings at seven a.m. every weekday.
cards.example_zh: 每个工作日，我的闹钟都在早上七点响。
cards.explain_zh: 放在钟点后；12 a.m.是午夜，12 p.m.是正午。

cards.example_en: My brother does the cooking while I wash dishes.
cards.example_zh: 我哥哥做饭，我洗碗。
cards.explain_zh: cooking指烹饪活动；cook可指厨师，cooker指炊具。

cards.example_en: Teaching basic cooking skills at school can help young people develop healthier eating habits.
cards.example_zh: 在学校教授基本烹饪技能，有助于年轻人养成更健康的饮食习惯。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: This shelf is just over a metre long.
cards.example_zh: 这个架子长一米多一点。
cards.explain_zh: 长度单位英式写metre，美式写meter；复数metres。

cards.example_en: This shelf is just over a metre long.
cards.example_zh: 这个架子长一米多一点。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: I packed my toothbrush in the side pocket.
cards.example_zh: 我把牙刷装进了侧面的口袋。
cards.explain_zh: 复数是toothbrushes，不是teethbrushes。

cards.example_en: This bakery makes the best bread in our neighbourhood.
cards.example_zh: 这家面包店做的面包是我们街区最好的。
cards.explain_zh: best是good和well的最高级；形容词前通常加the。

cards.example_en: We usually do our shopping early on Saturday mornings.
cards.example_zh: 我们通常在星期六一早去购物。
cards.explain_zh: shopping作名词不可数；“去购物”用go shopping。

cards.example_en: The growth of online shopping has changed consumer habits and increased demand for home delivery services.
cards.example_zh: 网上购物的发展改变了消费者习惯，也增加了对送货上门服务的需求。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: My little sister learned the alphabet through a song.
cards.example_zh: 我的小妹妹通过一首歌学会了字母表。
cards.explain_zh: alphabet指整套字母；单个字母用letter。

cards.example_en: He trimmed his beard before leaving for work.
cards.example_zh: 他上班出门前修剪了胡须。
cards.explain_zh: beard指下巴及两颊胡须；moustache指上唇胡须。

cards.example_en: We shared Chinese dumplings at a small restaurant yesterday.
cards.example_zh: 昨天我们在一家小餐馆一起吃了中式饺子。
cards.explain_zh: 首字母始终大写；指一个中国人常用a Chinese person。

cards.example_en: She sharpened her pencil before sketching the sleeping cat.
cards.example_zh: 她削好铅笔，开始画那只熟睡的猫。
cards.explain_zh: 用铅笔写说in pencil；pencil in指暂定安排。

cards.example_en: I took the parcel to the post office before lunch.
cards.example_zh: 午饭前，我把包裹送到了邮局。
cards.explain_zh: 标准拼写为post office，两词之间不加连字符。

cards.example_en: A local post office can provide essential services for rural residents who lack reliable internet access.
cards.example_zh: 当地邮局可以为缺乏可靠网络连接的农村居民提供基本服务。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: We shared a traditional German cake after dinner.
cards.example_zh: 晚饭后，我们分着吃了一块传统德国蛋糕。
cards.explain_zh: 首字母须大写；指德语时通常不加冠词。

cards.example_en: She sliced a carrot and added it to the soup.
cards.example_zh: 她把一根胡萝卜切片，放进汤里。
cards.explain_zh: 比喻奖励或诱因；carrot and stick指奖惩并用。

cards.example_en: My sister baked a lemon cake for my birthday.
cards.example_zh: 姐姐为我的生日烤了一个柠檬蛋糕。
cards.explain_zh: 在某人生日当天用on，不用in或at。

cards.example_en: She spread some butter on a slice of warm bread.
cards.example_zh: 她在一片温热的面包上抹了些黄油。
cards.explain_zh: butter是黄油，cream是奶油；作食品名通常不可数。

cards.example_en: We cooked Italian pasta with tomatoes and fresh basil.
cards.example_zh: 我们用番茄和新鲜罗勒做了意大利面。
cards.explain_zh: 国籍和语言名称首字母大写；意大利人复数为Italians。

cards.example_en: Studying Italian architecture can help students understand how historical buildings influence contemporary urban design.
cards.example_zh: 研究意大利建筑可以帮助学生理解历史建筑如何影响当代城市设计。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: My grandfather taught me how to grow tomatoes.
cards.example_zh: 我的祖父教过我如何种番茄。
cards.explain_zh: 不区分父系母系；外祖父可说maternal grandfather。

cards.example_en: I practise Spanish with my neighbour after dinner.
cards.example_zh: 晚饭后我和邻居一起练习西班牙语。
cards.explain_zh: 首字母大写；一个西班牙人可说a Spanish person。

cards.example_en: These pants have deep pockets for my keys.
cards.example_zh: 这条裤子的口袋很深，可以装我的钥匙。
cards.explain_zh: 美式指裤子，英式常指内裤；用 a pair of 计数。

cards.example_en: We go dancing together at the community centre every Saturday.
cards.example_zh: 我们每周六都一起去社区中心跳舞。
cards.explain_zh: 作活动名词通常不可数；去跳舞用go dancing。

cards.example_en: We go dancing together at the community centre every Saturday.
cards.example_zh: 我们每周六都一起去社区中心跳舞。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: The toilet upstairs keeps making a strange dripping sound.
cards.example_zh: 楼上的马桶一直发出奇怪的滴水声。
cards.explain_zh: 美式toilet通常指马桶；问公共洗手间常用restroom。

cards.example_en: Access to clean public toilets is essential for protecting health and making urban spaces welcoming to everyone.
cards.example_zh: 提供干净的公共厕所，对保障健康和打造人人友好的城市空间至关重要。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: We travelled around Japan by train during our holiday.
cards.example_zh: 假期里，我们乘火车游览了日本。
cards.explain_zh: 国名首字母大写，通常不加the；日本人用Japanese。

cards.example_en: The lion rested beneath a tree in the shade.
cards.example_zh: 那头狮子在树荫下休息。
cards.explain_zh: 狮群用a pride of lions；母狮称lioness。

cards.example_en: My sister is interested in learning to grow vegetables.
cards.example_zh: 我姐姐对学习种菜很感兴趣。
cards.explain_zh: 人感到有兴趣用interested；后接in加名词或动名词。

cards.example_en: My sister is interested in learning to grow vegetables.
cards.example_zh: 我姐姐对学习种菜很感兴趣。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: The bookstore near my flat stays open until nine.
cards.example_zh: 我公寓附近的书店一直营业到九点。
cards.explain_zh: bookstore是美式常用词，不是借书的library。

cards.example_en: We put fresh flowers on the dining-room table.
cards.example_zh: 我们在饭厅的餐桌上摆了鲜花。
cards.explain_zh: 现代通常写作dining room，指用餐房间。

cards.example_en: We put fresh flowers on the dining-room table.
cards.example_zh: 我们在饭厅的餐桌上摆了鲜花。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: I felt hungry after our long walk by the river.
cards.example_zh: 在河边走了很久之后，我觉得饿了。
cards.explain_zh: hungry for后接名词，表示渴望某物。

cards.example_en: I added cucumber and tomatoes to the salad.
cards.example_zh: 我往沙拉里加了黄瓜和番茄。
cards.explain_zh: 可指一份沙拉，也可不可数地指沙拉这种食物。

cards.example_en: The children were excited about their first camping trip.
cards.example_zh: 孩子们对第一次露营旅行感到兴奋。
cards.explain_zh: 人感到兴奋用excited；事物令人兴奋用exciting。

cards.example_en: The children were excited about their first camping trip.
cards.example_zh: 孩子们对第一次露营旅行感到兴奋。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: My American neighbour invited us over for pumpkin pie.
cards.example_zh: 我的美国邻居邀请我们去他家吃南瓜派。
cards.explain_zh: 首字母始终大写；通常指美国，而非整个美洲。

cards.example_en: We cooked Russian dumplings for dinner last night.
cards.example_zh: 昨晚我们做了俄式饺子当晚餐。
cards.explain_zh: 首字母须大写；指俄语时通常不加冠词。

cards.example_en: Studying Russian literature can help students explore how historical events influence cultural identity and artistic expression.
cards.example_zh: 学习俄罗斯文学可以帮助学生探究历史事件如何影响文化认同和艺术表达。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: My cousin moved to Britain to study nursing.
cards.example_zh: 我的表亲搬到英国学习护理。
cards.explain_zh: Britain常指英国；Great Britain不包括北爱尔兰。

cards.example_en: The giraffe stretched its neck to reach the highest leaves.
cards.example_zh: 那只长颈鹿伸长脖子去够最高处的叶子。
cards.explain_zh: 重音在第二音节，复数通常加-s。

cards.example_en: I borrowed an eraser to correct my pencil drawing.
cards.example_zh: 我借了一块橡皮擦来修改铅笔画。
cards.explain_zh: eraser常用于美式英语；英式英语常说rubber。

cards.example_en: My British neighbour invited us over for tea.
cards.example_zh: 我的英国邻居邀请我们过去喝茶。
cards.explain_zh: 英国人总称用the British；单个人用a Briton。

cards.example_en: My typing has become faster since I started practising.
cards.example_zh: 开始练习以后，我的打字速度变快了。
cards.explain_zh: 作名词时不可数；也是type的现在分词。
